events.title: Grover Cleveland is born
events.description: Stephen Grover Cleveland was born in Caldwell, New Jersey. He went on to become the only U.S. president to serve two non-consecutive terms, as both the 22nd and 24th president.
events.significance: His split terms in the White House remain unique in American history.

events.title: Neville Chamberlain is born
events.description: The future British Prime Minister was born in 1869. He led Britain from 1937 to 1940.
events.significance: He is closely linked with the policy of appeasement toward Nazi Germany, including the 1938 Munich Agreement.

events.title: The Évian Accords end the Algerian War
events.description: France and Algerian nationalist leaders signed the Évian Accords, which set a ceasefire in a brutal war that had lasted since 1954.
events.significance: The agreement paved the way for Algerian independence from France later that year.

events.title: Alexei Leonov walks in space
events.description: Soviet cosmonaut Alexei Leonov left the Voskhod 2 spacecraft while it was in orbit. He floated on a tether for about 12 minutes.
events.significance: It was the first spacewalk in history, and a major milestone in the Cold War space race.

events.title: East Germany holds its first free elections
events.description: East Germans voted in the only free parliamentary election in the country's history, a few months after the peaceful revolution of 1989.
events.significance: The vote cleared the way for German reunification, which was completed in October 1990.
